title: Internship, Graphic Design (Winter/Spring 2027)
term: Winter/Spring 2027 (from about Jan 2027, at least 12 weeks)
location: Austin, TX or Palo Alto, CA (on-site)
note: Graphic design intern on Tesla's People Content creative team making HR and recruiting visuals; portfolio required.

facts.duties: Concept and produce people/HR visual content across digital, motion, print, events and internal campaigns; turn briefs into designs, check brand consistency, present and iterate.
facts.requirements: Enrolled student with graphic design fundamentals (type, layout, hierarchy, branding), Figma and Adobe CC skills, and a portfolio; motion, illustration or photography is a plus; full-time 40 hrs/week for at least 12 weeks.
facts.apply: Apply online via Tesla careers (listing found on ev.careers, posted 2026-11-12; tesla.com page blocks automated fetch).
